MINUTES OF JUNE 7, 2022
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Ding called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:36
  P.M. on Tuesday, June 7, 2022, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission
  Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL
  Council Members Present:  Denise Menchaca, Carina Rivera, John Wu, Vice Mayor
  John R. Harrington, and Mayor Tony Ding.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City Attorney
  Martin Koczanowicz, Police Chief Eugene Harris, Ch ief
  City Clerk Sharon Clark, Public Works Director/City
  Engineer Greg de Vinck, Fire Chief Steven Wallace,
  Human Resources/Risk Management Director Edward
  Macias,  Finance  Director  William  Kaholokula,
  Community Development Director Aldo Cervantes, and

I  ANNOUNCEMENTS
  Assistant City Clerk Marilyn Bonus.

  Chief City Clerk Clark provided information for the public on how to view the meeting and
  how to request meeting agendas.

  1. STUDY SESSION

  A. ROLE OF THE CITY COUNCIL IN AN EMERGENCY AND DISASTER OPERATIONS

  Fire Chief Wallace and Soraya Sutherlin, Disaster Management Area Coordinator,
  Area "C," made the presentation .

  Debbie Kilgore, resident, posed questions about City staff communications during
  an emergency and made suggestions about emergency provisions.

  Discussion included the City's response to past disasters; involving City

I  commissioners in disaster planning; multi -lingual communication during
  emergencies; mutual-aid provisions; pro-active efforts by Southern California
  Edison to mitigate transformer-fire hazards in the City and coordination with City
  staff and residents; a possible future study session on this topic; and planned table-
  top training exercises.

  2.  ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:35 P.M .
